native_feature_difference: Native prior GPS common-input/raw-phase baseline versus Rust calibrated-phase GPS PPP and optional GPS/Galileo native-variance-QC SPP/Doppler seeds. Native SPP broadcast/no DCB; native precise effective clock random walk versus Rust IndependentEpoch; native built-in/header-zero initialization versus Rust native-head/PVA. Only initial ZTD uncertainty is changed in Rust; the product/IF model is not relabeled native broadcast or MADOCA. No new native whole-PPP calls.
